Hair regrowth timeline

What to expect with treatment.

Get started today

1-3 months

Activate

Some shedding may occur at this stage of your hair growth cycle, while follicles are hard at work making way for new hair.

3-6 months

Stimulate

You may notice baby hairs beginning to fill in—and hair loss slowing down.

6+ months

Regrow

Areas of thinning hair may become less noticeable, with improved hair density and scalp coverage.

Doctor-trusted ingredients + supplemental support
Get started

Prevent hair loss

Finasteride works by blocking an enzyme that converts testosterone into DHT, a hormone that can weaken hair follicles.

Promote regrowth

Minoxidil kickstarts new growth by waking up dormant follicles and increasing how long they stay in the active growth phase.

Support healthy hair

Ketoconazole improves scalp health. It targets bacteria to clear the way for biotin to support healthy hair.
